name: earth-network-countdown
description: Earth Network Countdown - 4K Remotion compositions (WebGL 2 shaders): V1 reference match (sunrise), V2 aurora colour-palette alternative

scripts.downscale:v1: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('out/1080p',{recursive:true})" && remotion ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/4k/Version-1_Earth-Network-Countdown_Reference-Match_4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -an -movflags +faststart -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 out/1080p/Version-1_Earth-Network-Countdown_Reference-Match_1080p.mp4
scripts.downscale:v2: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('out/1080p',{recursive:true})" && remotion ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/4k/Version-2_Earth-Network-Countdown_Aurora-Palette_4K.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -an -movflags +faststart -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 out/1080p/Version-2_Earth-Network-Countdown_Aurora-Palette_1080p.mp4
scripts.render:v1: npm run render:v1:4k && npm run downscale:v1
scripts.render:v2: npm run render:v2:4k && npm run downscale:v2
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
